verdict.rationale: Omarchy offers a one-menu path (Install > Windows) to run a Windows VM via Docker, using hardware virtualization, a shared clipboard and a shared folder. That is quick and needs little manual setup, but it covers only Windows and requires your own Windows 11 Pro license. There is no evidence of general-purpose VM creation for other guest operating systems. Missing for 10: general VM creation and management beyond Windows, documentation of other guest OS support, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Windows VM flow.
